verdict.rationale: Cal.com is a scheduling platform, so AI time-blocking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, only covers booking pages, availability APIs, rescheduling endpoints, and an MCP server that lets external AI clients manage bookings. These are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not a native capability that turns a user's tasks into calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines and re-plans them automatically.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI schedules my tasks into real calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and re-plans automatically when things change
